name: io.github.Servosity/mspbots-mcp
title: MSPbots MCP
description: Readable filters, alias-named resources, full exports, and the KPI history MSPbots doesn't keep.

environmentVariables.name: MSPBOTS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the MSPBOTS_API_KEY credential for the MSPbots MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MSPBOTS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the MSPbots API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: MSPBOTS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: MSPBOTS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on MSPbots requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

environmentVariables.name: MSPBOTS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: MSPBOTS_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.
